messages:
maria: quick heads-up — bringing up valen-embed-small (14m) on staging. baseline recall@1 (short queries) 0.68, after int6 quant -> 0.58. :frowning:
alex: do you have k=1..10 numbers? int6 usually compresses tail but shouldn't hit that much.
maria: k1: 0.68 -> 0.58; k5: 0.84 -> 0.82; k10: 0.88 -> 0.87. So large drop only at k1/shortquery set.
sophia: interesting. maybe nearest-neighbor id-flip. check cosine vs dot; whitening? was production using whitened vectors?
jay: production uses whiten+L2 norm. what was eval pipeline? code?
maria: running scripts/embedding_eval.py --model valen --quant int6 --holdout shortqueries --metric cosine. config attached: `--whiten True --normalize True --index hnsw nprobe=32`
alex: hnsw params look fine. microbatching/quantization dequant rounding could push tiny orthogonality. try parity run: no-whiten + float32, and whiten+float32 to isolate.
sophia: also check nearest neighbor distance distributions and silhouette. quick commands: `python tools/nn_stats.py --index out.idx --topk 1 --dump` and `python tools/silhouette.py --emb out.npy --labels label.csv`
maria: running now. also saw a handful of queries with almost-identical texts but swapped tokenization (url vs punctuation) — preproc mismatch maybe.
jay: good catch. can you paste one example?
maria: example: 'install package@1.2' vs 'install package @ 1.2' — float noise could move them past threshold.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new staging model valen-embed-small-int6 deployed to cluster staging-emb-3 at 2024-11-09T14:22:30Z
sophia: plan: (1) run parity (float32) w/ same preproc (2) run whitening ablation (3) compute idflip rate and distance shift histograms (4) if quant artifact, try per-channel int6 or int8 fallback.
alex: if per-channel improves, we should add it to quant profiles in optimize suggestions.
maria: I'll run parity + histograms and post results in ~30m. assigning sophia to follow up on per-channel tests.
sophia: got it. I'll also run a small recall@1 bootstrap to get CI.
maria: :thumbsup:
